environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an AWS Classic Load Balancer (CLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database at /var/data/users.db contains production user records including admin accounts with password hashes.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic Load Balancer, TCP mode, no HTTP-level inspection
